rules.regex: ^(?:ho gaya|ho gya|hogya|kar diya|kar dia|done|ready|fix hua|fix ho gaya|build hua|build ho gaya|apk ready|test hua|complete|kya hua|kitna hua|ab|aur|fir|phir|kab tak)\??$
rules.hint: Status/follow-up about the most recent active task. Report the latest verified stage concisely.
Resolve the reference from recent conversation, preferring the immediately previous relevant target.
Modify the current target and preserve previously accepted work.
Preserve all unrelated working functions; make only the requested incremental change.
Continue from the last verified state; do not redo already completed work.
Answer the immediate question first, then continue implementation details.
Ordinary build/test failures may be repaired automatically, but do not bypass owner approval for final install or destructive actions.
Scope the change to only the named capability when architecture permits; prefer a hot pack for language/context-only changes.
Prefer the smallest supported update path: understanding pack, function pack, or signed in-place APK only when compiled core code must change.
Interpret as Anamika's owner-controlled self-upgrade workflow with validation, repair, build, verification and owner-approved install.
Bridge means one-time core support that enables future small packs/modules; it must preserve existing functions unless explicitly removed.
This is a runtime language/context/rules update and should not require a full APK when current bridge support is installed.
This is a compatible declarative workflow/function update using installed safe core actions; do not confuse it with arbitrary compiled Java code.
Treat this as source/update input that may be repaired and rebuilt locally; compiled core changes still activate through a newly signed APK.
Treat supplied source text as direct-code input; identify language, likely target function/class and estimated benefit before/with processing.
Do not create parallel duplicate implementations; update the existing implementation in place and use duplicate guard.
Old installed versions remain in private archive until explicit owner deletion; never auto-delete them.
This is an explicit owner request to delete retained old-version archives only, not the current version.
Use the evidence-based update scorecard: quality %, problem/regression %, core-probe delta, crashes, source verification and healthy launches.
Treat as understanding/reply defect; use recent context to distinguish parsing, local model inference, duplicate inference, timeout or runtime failure.
Treat as app lifecycle/crash/watchdog issue, not automatically as a language issue.
Interpret in wake/voice context unless sentence clearly addresses Anamika conversationally.
Consider wake listener audio ownership, app lifecycle/background behavior and media/call coexistence.
Interpret as app-discovery/automation/plugin/UI wiring context and preserve existing accessibility/plugin functions.
Interpret as automated app discovery/blueprint request; distinguish observation/accessibility capability from unsupported assumptions about arbitrary apps.
Use latest verified repository/build state; do not claim success while CI is queued or running.
Interpret as Android signing/update identity or signer-provisioning UI context. Same signing certificate is required for in-place APK updates.
Interpret as Android local-build/toolchain compatibility and keep min SDK, target SDK and device OS version meanings distinct.
Interpret as Anamika's local coding/inference stack, not cloud ChatGPT.
Recheck the current target comprehensively, but report only checks actually performed.
Respond concisely with current result/status; do not mirror frustration or invent progress.
Provide or diagnose the latest verified artifact delivery; do not rebuild unless the artifact itself is outdated/broken.
APK candidates belong to Self Update; Understanding/Function Pack ZIPs belong to Components. Do not mix the two paths.
Check signer mismatch, versionCode downgrade, package identity, storage or corrupted download before guessing.
For numeric follow-ups reuse the immediately relevant figures/rates and units, then recompute.
Reuse the most recent matching numeric context; do not restart with older rates.
Keep purchase rate, gift/send amount, returned coins/diamonds, salary and room reward as separate quantities; latest corrected rate overrides older assumptions.
Rewrite/translate the immediately relevant prior text into clear English; preserve whether it is a question or statement.
When following an English draft, translate that same draft into natural Hindi unless context clearly asks something else.
Preserve meaning and factual details while improving clarity/tone; do not invent new facts.
Merge the new content into the immediately preceding draft instead of starting a separate message.
Treat as follow-up to the current design/image/UI target and preserve accepted choices unless explicitly changed.
Interpret as functional interaction requirement, not just visual design.
This likely belongs to the separate voice-chat app; do not mix it with Anamika core unless explicitly connected.
Treat as a behavioral constraint in the voice-chat app: seats must not change state automatically unless explicitly designed.
In the voice-chat app context, the user who creates the room is the room owner unless later requirements change it.
Use the latest platform/policy context and role structure; do not mix older policy percentages with newer policy text.
Use the supplied visual/video as a behavior/layout reference and preserve the most recently clarified target.
Explain the immediately referenced technical item from recent context before introducing unrelated concepts.
Answer capability directly, then state the exact technical boundary and supported path.
Verify/preserve existing functions; distinguish code-line replacement from actual feature removal.
Explain how the current modular architecture affects future updates and which update path will be used.
Interpret as Android in-place update compatibility: package identity, signing certificate and monotonically higher versionCode matter.
Do not declare superiority from install alone; use post-update scorecard, crashes, source checks and healthy launches.
Use recent conversation continuity, shorthand normalization and owner style profile; ask clarification only when ambiguity remains after context resolution.
Preserve the latest explicit requirements from recent context; do not regress to an older design/behavior assumption.
Treat as owner correction. Replace the prior interpretation with the corrected one and do not defend the old assumption.
Keep scope narrow to the explicitly requested change.
Only claim complete when all requested implementation/build/test stages that can actually be verified are done; separate untested real-device behavior.
